title: Add 'Unlimited Sessions' display to Premium subscription tier

requirements.text: On the SubscriptionPackagesPage, update the Premium subscription tier to prominently display 'Unlimited Sessions' as a key benefit. The feature list for the Premium plan must include 'Unlimited Sessions' as a line item, clearly distinguishing it from the Basic and Standard tiers which show a fixed session count. This text must be visible in the plan card, any comparison table, and any confirmation or summary UI on that page.

quotes: you didn't make the unlimited sessions in the subscription page

acceptanceCriteria: The Premium subscription plan card on SubscriptionPackagesPage displays 'Unlimited Sessions' (or equivalent phrasing) as a listed benefit.
Basic and Standard tiers continue to show their fixed session counts (not 'unlimited').
The 'Unlimited Sessions' label is visually distinct and clearly readable within the plan card.
No other subscription tier incorrectly shows 'unlimited sessions'.
The page renders without errors and the premium plan badge/highlight remains intact.

constraints: Do not modify any files under frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui.
Do not change the prices of any subscription tier.
Do not alter the Stripe checkout flow or session count logic — this is a display-only change.
nonGoals: Modifying backend subscription data models or session-count enforcement logic.
Updating any dashboard other than SubscriptionPackagesPage.
